journey.name: Saarthi hands-free voice on connected Android
journey.description: Verify the installed release opens, starts an inline voice conversation, exposes pause/correction controls and can end without a recording dialog.

actions.action: Verify version 1.2.2 build 2007 is installed and launches
Tap the observed start conversation control
Verify inline voice state, Pause, Correct and Type controls without a recording dialog
Tap Pause and verify Resume is available
Tap Type and verify inline editor and Send are visible
Tap End and verify the starting Saarthi screen returns
